task:
Implement `parse` in `src/lib.rs`. It currently calls `todo!()`.

`parse(input: &str) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>, ParseError>` reads
lines of `key = value`. Blank lines and lines whose first non-space
character is `#` are skipped. Each other line must contain `=`; the key
is the trimmed text before the first `=`, the value the trimmed text
after it (a value may itself contain `=`). Errors, with 1-based line
numbers: `MissingEquals(line)` when there is no `=`, `EmptyKey(line)`
when the trimmed key is empty, `Duplicate(key)` when a key repeats.
Pairs are returned in input order. No crates outside std.
